# Ella Langley Chooses Denver for SiriusXM’s Small Stage Series


September 23, 2026 10:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_8ad52b303f67d3a3cc20333bfe564038/siriusxm/news/2026-09-23_Ella_Langley_Chooses_Denver_for_SiriusXM_s_Small_2306.pdf)


***Special performance on October 6 at The Grizzly Rose to air on SiriusXM’s The Highway***


****


**NEW YORK, NY – September 23, 2026 –** SiriusXM today announced that country’s newest superstar **Ella Langley** will take the stage for a special SiriusXM performance on Tuesday, October 6 at The Grizzly Rose in Denver, Colorado ** presented by *REESE’S* .


Part of SiriusXM’s Small Stage Series, the intimate show will feature the rising country star performing her hits, fan favorites and songs from her latest album *Dandelion* .


SiriusXM listeners across North America will be able to experience Ella Langley’s exclusive full performance on SiriusXM’s The Highway on Friday, October 9 at 8:00 pm ET. The concert will also be available anytime on the SiriusXM app.


“Ella Langley is having an incredible moment right now, and it’s exciting to have her bring that energy to SiriusXM’s Small Stage Series,” said Scott Greenstein, SiriusXM's President and Chief Content Officer. “She has quickly become one of the most exciting voices in country music, and this special show is the perfect opportunity to bring fans even closer to Ella at this incredible moment in her career.”


SiriusXM subscribers and fans can enter for a chance to win a pair of tickets to the show presented by *REESE’S* - click[HERE](https://www.siriusxm.com/ellaticketspr) for full details. If you do not live in the Denver area, you can also enter for your chance to win a VIP trip to the concert - click[HERE](https://www.siriusxm.com/ellalangleytrippr) for full details. At the show *REESE’S* will treat fans to a flavorful on-site experience with exclusive surprises, giveaways and product sampling.


Ella Langley’s show continues SiriusXM’s exclusive ongoing Small Stage Series featuring performances with premier artists spanning music genres and styles held in small iconic venues. SiriusXM launched its Small Stage Series in August 2021 and to date has included performances by artists including Alicia Keys, Brandi Carlile, Coldplay, Dave Matthews, Ed Sheeran, Green Day, H.E.R., Hilary Duff, J Balvin, J. Cole, Jason Aldean, Kane Brown, Kenny Chesney, Lainey Wilson and more.


Eligible customers can get their first three months of SiriusXM for free. Click[here](https://siriusxm.com/Get3mosFree) to sign up and experience all that SiriusXM has to offer. See Offer Details.


###


**About Ella Langley**


Ella Langley is a multi-platinum, chart-topping, and award-winning country artist whose unmistakable voice, fearless songwriting, and magnetic live presence have made her one of the genre’s defining new stars. After breaking out with her acclaimed debut album *hungover* , Ella entered a new chapter with *Dandelion* , her Platinum-certified and critically acclaimed sophomore album executive produced alongside Miranda Lambert and Ben West. The album debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 and delivered the biggest streaming week for a country album by a woman in two years.


Rooted in growth, self-reflection, and lived-in storytelling, *Dandelion* features standout hits including the 6x Platinum “Choosin’ Texas” and Platinum-certified “Be Her.” “Choosin’ Texas” has become one of the defining hits of the year, breaking records week by week and becoming the longest-running Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 of all time. Ella also swept all seven of her nominations at the 61st ACM Awards, including Female Artist of the Year, Song of the Year, Single of the Year, and Artist-Songwriter of the Year.


With sold-out tours, chart-topping hits, major award recognition, and a growing list of collaborations across music, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle, Ella continues to expand the boundaries of what a modern country star can be.
